name: Meme Top 5 Active Buyer Index

selection.discovery: DEX Screener and GeckoTerminal Solana discovery plus the curated seed universe
selection.ranking: 30-minute qualified buy USD when identity-quality coverage is complete
selection.buyerEstimate: unique signing wallets after transaction deduplication, burst-automation filtering, and sub-1-USD dust filtering
selection.fallbackRanking: wallet-observed gross buy USD, then one-hour market buy-volume proxy; fallbacks are not publishable as token NAV

coverage.completeWhen: the response contains fewer than 300 trades or its oldest trade predates the 30-minute cutoff
coverage.incompleteHandling: publish as an explicitly labeled lower bound

weighting.rebalance: daily at 00:00 UTC and on emergency constituent replacement
weighting.continuity: a basket-unit and index-divisor state preserves the index level across rebalances

backingTarget.onchainVaultVerification: Squads v4 owner, Token-2022 authorities, token balances and supply
backingTarget.status: design target; custody is not connected

publication.signedSnapshots: Ed25519 signature and SHA-256 content digest
publication.externalOracleAttestations: two independent Ed25519 signers over the exact content digest

limitations: A blockchain address is not a person.
The active-buyer estimate does not currently merge every wallet controlled by one person.
Primary-pool observations may omit trades on other pools.
A saturated 300-trade response is a lower bound.
The rolling public index is not itself a redeemable financial product.
The 102% backing model is not evidence that reserve assets currently exist.
